title: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 — Rule 18, notice of meeting

content.note: Secondary reproduction of Rule 18, not Gazette-primary. The reproduced text addresses electronic notice, recipient email address, annual opportunity to register/update an email address, subject-line particulars, non-editable attachments/links, proof-of-sending records, transmission/failure allocation, and readability/retention of linked notice material. The official G.S.R. 560(E), 13 June 2018, notification confirms that the Explanation after rule 18(3)(ix) was omitted. This confirms that deletion only; the full consolidated current Rule 18 and all amendments remain to be reconciled against official primary sources. An official 28 August 2020 Gazette notification's amendment-history note also lists the sequence of amendment notifications through G.S.R. 560(E), 13 June 2018, including G.S.R. 175(E), 16 February 2018. The 2020 instrument's operative amendment is to rule 12; this history note does not establish post-August-2020 changes or independently certify consolidated Rule 18. An official Gazette notification G.S.R. 801(E), 27 October 2023, also amends Rule 9 rather than Rule 18 and prints an amendment-history note stating that the principal Rules were last amended by G.S.R. 44(E), 21 January 2023. This adds limited evidence from the 2023 instrument only; it does not certify consolidated Rule 18 or establish the absence of later amendments. A further 2025 amendment-chain lead has now been recorded for G.S.R. 358(E), 30 May 2025. Indexed reproductions describe that instrument as substituting Forms MGT-7, MGT-7A and MGT-15 in the Annexure and identify G.S.R. 403(E), 15 July 2024, as the preceding amendment. The official Gazette PDF URL has been identified but could not be independently retrieved in this pass; treat this as an unresolved source lead, not primary-text verification. These form-only summaries do not establish the complete current Rule 18 or exclude later amendments. An official MCA-hosted copy of G.S.R. 403(E), 15 July 2024, has now been retrieved; its operative change is substitution of Form MGT-6 in the Annexure, not Rule 18. This narrows the scope of that specific instrument only. The 2025 G.S.R. 358(E) Gazette PDF remains independently unretrieved, and this limited amendment-chain evidence does not establish the full consolidated current Rule 18. The 2025 G.S.R. 358(E) lead has since been checked against the full text reproduced by secondary sources, and an official Rajya Sabha record lists the notification among MCA notifications laid before the House (https://cms.rajyasabha.nic.in/UploadedFiles/Debates/OfficialDebatesDatewise/Floor/268/582025/05082025.pdf). The reproduced operative clauses substitute Forms MGT-7, MGT-7A and MGT-15 in the Annexure with effect from 14 July 2025; this is form-only amendment scope and does not amend Rule 18 on its face. The official Gazette PDF at https://egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2025/263573.pdf was not independently retrieved, so do not treat this as primary-text verification or a complete current Rule 18 chain. A separate High Court-hosted PDF of the original Rules text was also inspected at https://thc.nic.in/Central%20Governmental%20Rules/Companies%20%28Management%20and%20Administration%29%20Rules%2C2014.pdf. That copy labels itself “[To be Published in the Gazette]” and is dated 27 March 2014 without the final G.S.R. 260(E) number, so it is recorded only as a court-hosted baseline text, not as the final Gazette instrument. It aligns with the known limited amendment evidence for Rule 18, but does not close the consolidated-current-rule source gate. The official Gazette PDF for G.S.R. 279(E), 6 April 2022, was also inspected: its operative amendment inserts rule 14(3), not rule 18, and its amendment-history note lists prior instruments through G.S.R. 159(E), 5 March 2021. This is limited instrument-scope evidence only; it does not establish that no other instrument amended Rule 18 or certify a consolidated current text. A further instrument-scope check inspected IndiaCode's reproduction of the Gazette text for G.S.R. 175(E), 16 February 2018. The notification's operative rule substitutes Forms MGT-6 and MGT-15 in the Annexure; it does not amend Rule 18 on its face. This narrows that instrument's scope only and does not prove the complete Rule 18 amendment chain or current consolidated text. Additional scope check on 9 October 2026: the official MCA-hosted G.S.R. 159(E), 5 March 2021 (https://www.mca.gov.in/Ministry/pdf/CompaniesMgmtAdminAmndtRules_11032021.pdf) substitutes Rule 11(1) and Rule 12, not Rule 18. IndiaCode's reproduction of G.S.R. 44(E), 21 January 2023 (https://indiacode.ecourtsindia.com/rules/g-s-r-no-44-e-companies-management-and-administration-amendment-rules-3a85c8f3/) describes changes to Annexure Forms MGT-3 and MGT-14, not Rule 18. These checks narrow the scope of these two instruments only; neither establishes the complete amendment chain or consolidated current Rule 18.
